values.note: Takes larger RVs (no length posted). Up to 8 people and one RV plus two tents (or three tents) per site; every vehicle must fit on the parking spur, no parking on the grass.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground ('has 20 sites and can accommodate larger recreational vehicles'; 'A maximum of eight people is allowed per site'; 'A maximum three tents or one RV and two tents is allowed per site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165440 (20 sites; 'all vehicles must fit in the parking spur. Please no parking on the grass'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The water system was off in 2025 and 2026; bring water, including enough to drown a campfire. The RV dump stations at White Star and Printer Boy were closed for the 2026 season. Firewood $10 a bundle from the host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground ('Vault toilet is located near the entrance to the campground'; 'Potable water is not available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165440 (notice 'Water will not be available at this campground in 2026 ... the RV Dump Stations at White Star CG and Printer Boy CG will remain closed this season'; 'Firewood is available for sale at host site for $10.00/bundle'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Forest Service: 'generally open May through September', weather dependent; water, trash or a host may be missing early and late. Dates are recreation.gov's 2027 fee season (2026 ran May 22 - Sept 19).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground ('The facility is generally open May through September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165440/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-19; 2027-05-21 to 2027-09-18), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come only: claim a site in person; pay at the self-service fee tube (cash or check) or by Scan and Pay in the recreation.gov app, which needs the app downloaded before arrival (little cell service). A first-come site must be occupied the first night.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground ('available on a first-come, first-served basis only'; 'Fees are payable by cash, check or money order. A self-service fee tube is available.'; 'First-come, first-served sites must be occupied the first night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165440 (Scan and Pay overview), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $29 a site including two vehicles (an RV and its tow or towed vehicle count as one); $11 a night for a third vehicle, and boat/ATV trailers count as one. Overflow parking $25 a night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground ('$29 nightly fee per site for overnight camping, which includes two vehicles. A third vehicle is an additional $11 per night'; 'A fee of $25 per night will be charged for overflow parking') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165440/rates (2026-2028 first-come seasons: 29 site, 25 overflow), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike-San Isabel NF, on the east shore of Turquoise Lake beside the boat ramp and its parking areas, at ~9,900 ft (altitude sickness possible); moderate on weekdays, heavy on weekends. From Leadville, follow signs to the Turquoise Lake Recreation Area. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov: confirmed 20 sites, vault toilet, no water (2026), first-come only, $29 (2026); added season 05-21 to 09-18 (rec.gov 2027 fee season, FS 'May through September'), fee/vehicle detail, senior-pass discount; fees provenance now manual. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749 (FS page contact). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's line (661) 702-1420 (goexplorus.com).

Website is the forest home page; give the campground's own page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/matchless-campground (recreation.gov listing https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165440 is Scan-and-Pay only).

Waterfront (stored lakefront, no waterfront_evidence on the entry): both FS and recreation.gov say 'on the eastern shore of Turquoise Lake', so no contrary claim. But on imagery the shore-side pieces at the pin are the boat-ramp lot (at the water) and a long paved lot ~60-110 m inland behind a belt of conifers, with a ~20-40 m bare drawdown beach below the treeline; the sites are not resolvable (no recreation.gov per-site points; the one catalog point is the facility coordinate). Lakefront by open apron is not shown; worth a re-audit against a site map.
Max rig length: no agency figure ('can accommodate larger recreational vehicles'); recreation.gov has no per-site lengths.
FS page's water paragraph still says 'in 2025'; recreation.gov's notice says no water in 2026.

Access: PSICC alert (since April 7, 2026) closes Turquoise Lake Road (County Road 4) from the Abe Lee parking turnoff to Hagerman Pass; 'Access to Turquoise Lake is still available via County Road 9C and County Road 9'. Matchless is on the east shore near the dam end, so it should stay reachable.

Closure: the Willow Fire area closure (order 02-12-01-26-39, Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026) covers NFS lands south of Turquoise Lake and CR 4 toward Mount Massive; its Exhibit A map does not reach the east shore. Not a closure of Matchless.
Pin = FS/recreation.gov coordinate (39.25810,-106.35945); elevation 3,017 m matches FS 9,900 ft.
